title: tokenClub
tagline: A platform for token creation and buy/sell for several L2 networks, currently supporting arbitrum, base, scroll, morph, bnbchain.
description: The user can create a custom ERC20 token (gaming-general community assets, governance, educational institutions, and even meme coins who wants to be represented as an identity) with its supply, reserve and custom metadata. Once the tokens are created other users will see it on the explorer like Instagram does, and allows them to buy and sell it against the bonding curve. Another feature is the chatbox exclusive for token holders.
how_its_made:
Built on NextJs as general front and backend framework with Typescript.
For the UI we used TailwindCSS, Shadcn.
Solidity for the deployed smart contracts.
Privy for offering the smoothest user experience for new cryptocurrency users
Finally Viem is the SDK for gathering all toghether.
Current supported networks are: BNB Chain, Base, Arbitrum, Morph, Scroll.
